design.decision: Bid off the upgraded hand: more middle cards can stop a suit and low [♠]s become real trumps, so bids of 8 or more become reachable, while nil gets much harder.
design.opponent: Hidden until it changes who wins a trick; after that your team's middling cards keep beating theirs.
design.rationale: Upgrades filtered to low cards have measured best among enablers; this one never wastes the raise on honors already near [A] (unlike seed-raise), and any build that bids would buy it.
design.draftText: Opening: Raise every [2] through [8] your team holds by three ranks

critic.concerns: Near-duplicate of rc-junk-raise (range [2]-[8] vs [2]-[9], same +3); keep only one, and the raise family is already large (ca-raise-one, seed-raise, ua-side-raise, ua-spade-raise).
